annotations.title: Check a doctor's insurance plan listings

description: Checks which insurance plan directories list a doctor, by NPI or by name with an optional state, and optionally for one insurer such as Aetna, Cigna or Medicare. Returns each listing with its plans, its update date and whether the directory lists the doctor as accepting new patients, plus Medicare and Medicaid billing. No listing means unknown, not out of network. A listing does not confirm coverage. Only the plan can confirm it.

doctor_name.description: The doctor's full name, such as Matthew Bernhard. Use it when you have no NPI.

insurer.description: One insurer to check, using one of the listed ids, such as aetna or medicare.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.

name: check_doctor_insurance
